notes.title: 👑 OUT NOW: Reclaim your kingdom in We Never Yield!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904321/648f3726e4254cd946d1059f24588d0944e1dbbe.jpg[/img]

What up Doe!

It's such a great day for me: Because of all your support my second game [b]Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield[/b] is available as of now! The game plays as its own story but it picks up exactly where its predecessor left off in 2021:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jIl2Fo-pyc8

We Never Yield offers stylized parkour action as you run, jump, smash, and slide through various levels. And as the title suggests, you don't have to play alone this time. Take control of both brothers in single-player or conquer the game with a friend in two-player local cooperative mode and experience the all-new the story of Wally & Lone and their fight against their Aunt, Queen Karmic.

This game is a big step up for me: we have a dope all Black voice acting featuring [b]Blessing Adeoye Jr.[/b], [b]Belsheber Rusape Jr.[/b], and [b]Black Krystel[/b], a pulse-pounding soundtrack created by Detroit artist [b]Danime-Sama[/b] and myself, and much more. We also released the We Never Yield soundtrack [url=https://orcd.co/weneveryield][b]on all major music streaming platforms[/b][/url] together with Black Screen Records. So, run for it!

Again this game wouldn't be happening if it wasnt for all the support & love you've all showed by playing, wishlisting, streaming & sharing the first game.

Thank you so much for letting me make this game!
Aerial_Knight


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804740/Aerial_Knights_We_Never_Yield/

notes.title: 👑 Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield demo available now in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904321/6243f005b998d542131c354199c18ac10d429369.jpg[/img]

What's good everyone!

We're excited to announce that [b]Aerial_Knight's Never Yield [/b]now has a demo, just in time for Steam Next Fest! My talented friends at BetaJester have been working tirelessly to help me complete the game, and we're eager for you to try out this demo.

In this unique action game, you'll control two characters, playing solo or teaming up with a friend for local co-op, all set to an energetic soundtrack. The full game, coming soon, will feature over 15 Levels, Cutscenes, Challenge levels

We're still fine-tuning the game, so your feedback is invaluable. Share your thoughts in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ReEugsK][b]Discord[/b][/url], and let us know what you think! We love seeing positive comments, as it motivates our team to keep creating something amazing.

If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting the game. It helps us climb the charts and keeps you updated on the game's progress.

Thanks for your support!
Aerial_Knight


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804740/Aerial_Knights_We_Never_Yield/

notes.title: 👑 Reclaim your kingdom in We Never Yield from mid-July!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904321/b2fe89d05bed58f6303feff5d359ecd74f6901cd.jpg[/img]

What up Doe!

News of the day: We've just released a fresh trailer of We Never Yield showing you more fast-paced gameplay of our coming action co-op adventure! See the two brothers and main characters in action, both on foot, and in vehicles:

[previewyoutube=eNL0pnNj3kA;full][IGN YouTube TRAILER][/previewyoutube]
But there is actually no reason to talk about "soon" anymore, because the trailer actually reveals the release date of We Never Yield: From [u][b]July 16, 2024[/b][/u] you can reclaim your kingdom, alone or with a friend!

To keep you in the never yielding mood till mid-July, we also released the track "Wally's Theme" of the We Never Yield soundtrack [b][url=https://orcd.co/wallystheme]as a single on all major music streaming platforms[/url][/b] together with Black Screen Records. So, run for it!

That's it for now, but not for long. Talk to you again really soon!
Aerial_Knight


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804740/Aerial_Knights_We_Never_Yield/

notes.title: Running it back with Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904321/b7054fa78d4d2efed5dde9c364eac62a9dfe1772.jpg[/img]

Whats Good Y'all

Because of all your support I'm back with some dope news: a few minutes ago we unveiled and announced my second game [b]Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield[/b]! The game plays as its own story but it picks up exactly where its predecessor left off in 2021:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_eZ7dBtXZW8
We Never Yield offers you the well-known stylized parkour action as you run, jump, smash, and slide through various levels. And as the title suggests, you don't have to play alone this time! Take control of both characters in single-player or conquer the game with a friend in two-player local cooperative mode and experience the all-new the story of Wally & Lone and their fight against their Aunt, Queen Karmic.

This game is a big step up for me in We Never Yield: we have a dope all Black voice acting featuring Blessing Adeoye Jr., Belsheber Rusape Jr., and Black Krystel, a pulse-pounding soundtrack created by Detroit artist Danime-Sama and myself, and much more. I will tell you more about [b]Aerial_Knight's We Never Yield[/b] before its release in summer 2024.

So stay tuned and visit the Steam page from time to time. And if you like what you see don't hesitate to follow and wishlist the game - that would actually help a lot!

Again this game wouldn't be happening if it wasnt for all the support & love you've all showed by playing, wishlisting, streaming & sharing the first game. Thank you so much for letting me make this game!
Aerial_Knight
